about: Castle Protect animation list. Made by tools/art-gen/gen-sprites.mjs. Do not edit by hand. See assets/README.md

fields.frames: Sprite names from manifest.json, in play order. The order here is the truth, not the number in the name
fields.ms: Time for each frame in ms. Same count as frames
fields.loop: true: go round again at the end. false: play once
fields.loop_from: Only with loop. Frames before this index play once, then the loop runs from this index
fields.w_h_anchor: Size and anchor of every frame, px at @1x from the top left. All frames of one animation share them
fields.events: Name -> frame index. The event fires when that frame first shows
fields.next: Animation to start when a play-once animation ends
fields.hold: Sprite to show when a play-once animation ends
fields.pick: This is a set of poses, not a timed clip. Choose the frame by the named value
fields.random_start: Idle loops only. Start the loop at a random time in [0, sum of ms) so a crew never breathes in step. Each Hob also has its own ms
fields.start_offset_ms: Idle loops only. Time into the loop to start at when the app does not randomise. Differs per Hob and per team

ui_button_coin_spin.note: For coins that fly to the purse and for the reward card

ui_handoff_flip.note: Player 1 to player 2. Play backwards for player 2 to player 1

fort_bob.about: Fort body offset for each Stomper walk frame. dy is px at @1x (down is plus), tilt is degrees about the fort base centre. Add it to the fort body and all on it, not to the legs
fort_bob.note: Legs come in two sets, 3 frames apart, so a boot lands on frames 0 and 3. Play a dust puff and the step sound there. Reduce motion: dy and tilt are 0

collapse.about: Collapse beats from 06 section 6.3. View only. The sim has already dropped the blocks

creak.note: px at @1x. Play the crack overlay over each block that will fall

wobble_deg.about: Creak wobble before the lean, by material. Turn about the block base centre

lean.note: Tip the chunk toward the side with no support. Turn about the lower corner on the held side. Value = deg x track

drop.order: bottom row first, top row last
drop.note: Wicker flutters as it falls: swing by sway_deg, 200 ms each way

land.note: Squash about the base. Hit stop 50 ms if 3 or more blocks break

turn_banner.about: Turn banner slide. y is pt from its rest place (up is minus). The banner never blocks taps

hand_off_card.about: Scale for the card as it shows, on top of ui_handoff_flip
